Describes the AAARCC building as a two-storey 1927 house.

model_edits: Replaced the one-prism massing concept with a small two-storey clapboard house shell and exact GIS perimeter plinth.

Added steep asphalt-shingle gable roof, modest front porch roof and columns, chimney, fascia, gutters/downspouts, multi-pane sash windows, entry doors, sign, foundation, steps and accessible approach ramp.
Added a schematic interior featuring documented lounge/library, dining/kitchen, conference, and computer-lab use. Exact room partitions/furniture locations remain unverified.
Created procedural node textures for paint, shingle, stone, brick, glass, concrete, wood, and metal.
Kept all building geometry local around the official footprint envelope center; preview ground, camera, and lights are separate from the exported asset collection.
unresolved_or_review_needed: Google Maps Street View was independently identified by the coordinating agent; the subagent browser could not be opened from this thread. Its pano ID and URL are preserved above for grader review.

The main architectural mass is a compact house, not a large institutional building. The GIS outline includes a west porch-like projection; the model interprets it as an open covered porch based on front-entry imagery and the written orientation record.

Roof heights and room arrangement are not surveyed; reviewer should judge silhouette and facade against the linked Street View and Purdue official photographs before assigning a numeric fidelity score.
